item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 01/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will continue to bring showers to Guangdong today. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days, and then will be replaced gradually by a warm and humid southerly airstream. It will be misty over the coast of Guangdong in the morning and at night. The northeast monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 01/04 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Cloudy with a few showers. Visibility rather low in some areas.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
